scope: Explicit receive service geometry for interface-compatible open implementations; original measured CX5 fluid semantics remain the default.
classification: Prospective service-model relations before implementation or new study; prior downstream attribution is post-specified evidence, never a calibration input.
hard_semantics: One mutable occupancy and admission authority is selected immutably at construction; neither mode advances the other in an enabled run.
Default fluid construction and original C facade ABI1 layouts, counters, timestamps and trace results remain byte-equivalent.
Serialized service uses FIFO accepted packet lengths and public clock/configuration only, never RTL outputs, credits or occupancy.
At each clock, exact rational rate credit is accrued and clamped to token capacity; at most one packet-aligned beat is debited if its entire useful length is affordable.
Tail beats cannot be packed with the next packet in one clock. Debit precedes same-clock arrivals. An arrival cannot be served before the following clock.
Empty queue credit is cleared; idle intervals cannot accumulate credit for a future packet. The clock phase is a configuration input, never fitted to outputs.
Selected service occupancy drives capacity admission, drops, high-water and notifications, retaining existing sequence and packet-rate processing.
Invalid mode/configuration, zero period, zero width, unsafe arithmetic and unsupported ready semantics fail explicitly.
Finite backlog updates must avoid iteration proportional to unbounded idle time; exact rational arithmetic and overflow checks are required.
physical_relations: For a continuously backlogged constant length L and width W, raw useful service ceiling is8L/(period_ps*ceil(L/W))*1e12 bits/s.
An85-byte stream at5ns has raw ceiling68Gb/s for64-byte beats and136Gb/s for128-byte beats.
Token budget is an additional ceiling, not guaranteed useful throughput; beat-quantized debit may use fewer bytes than the fluid budget.
Increasing width or configured rate cannot worsen the constant-length steady service completion metric; saturation at the geometric ceiling is reported explicitly.

Below the serialization ceiling and away from finite start/tail effects, doubling a limiting token rate approximately halves the service term, with an exact clock-rounding bound derived before each fixture.
Selected occupancy equals accepted bytes minus serviced bytes exactly, never negative, and admission never exceeds capacity.
independent_controls: Hand-derived64/85/4096-byte scheduling fixtures for both widths and exact rational rates.
Same-clock arrival/service ordering and different explicit clock phases.
Empty-credit reset, finite token cap, capacity equality/rejection, FIFO packet tail and queued successor.
Default-fluid identity fixture and facade ABI/default failure behavior.
Negative copies for forbidden tail packing and idle credit banking must be caught by independent fixtures.
A selected service admission mutation that consults fluid occupancy must be caught at a geometry-dependent capacity edge.
gates: Native CMake build with warnings as errors and complete RNIC tests.
C facade ABI/default-fluid conformance, strict invalid-config and arithmetic-edge tests.
Small native receive example varying width and rate, with exact-or-bounded completion/occupancy/admission metrics against independent derived expectations.
Independent mathematical and code review of scheduling, conservation, monotonicity and physical bounds.
Owning module and example result records, docs-format check, ruff and pytest before upstream push.
Upstream lands on main before the downstream production vendor pin advances.
non_claims: This opt-in component mode is not a new CX5 silicon calibration.
No fabric-wide, request TTFT/TPOT, arbitrary downstream readiness or two-node wire certification closure follows from native component evidence.
Downstream strict64/128-byte matching bands remain unchanged and historical failed rows keep their original oracle and pin.
